summary: Iteration 8 — re-ran Group 8 Refund flow backend suite after main agent applied FIX 1 (admin lookup via _resolve_platform_admin helper using ADMIN_EMAIL env with role:{$in:[super_admin, admin]} fallback) and FIX 2 (idempotency check now precedes registration_paid gate). Result: 27/27 PASS (100%). Both previously-failing flows now green: (a) admin-side reversals — refund_revenue_reversal, refund_gst_reversal, refund_admin_funding_reversal, and platform_fee_reversal txns are now created and admin.wallet_buckets.direct_signup / gst_collected / platform_fee_collected are correctly decremented (test_admin_revenue_reversal_created, test_admin_funding_reversal_created_if_funding_existed, test_platform_fee_reversal_created all PASS); (b) idempotent re-POST of a soft-deleted user now returns 409 'User already refunded' instead of 400 (test_idempotency_409 PASS). All other invariants from iteration 7 remain intact: search/preview/clawback math, payouts reversed, bank_ledger debit, registration_inflow refunded=true, soft_delete sets is_blocked + registration_paid=false + status='deleted_refund', remove_referral re-parents downline + decrements grandparent.direct_referrals_count, Group 8 net-worth shape, Group 8 drilldown row, expense-category list with refunds removed, refund_debt absorption order in _credit_payout. Code-side verification confirmed _resolve_platform_admin at /app/backend/routes/refunds.py:49 used at lines 349 (per-payout platform-fee reversal) and 425 (revenue+GST reversal); idempotency `db.refunds.find_one({target_user_id})` 409 check at line 264 now runs BEFORE the `registration_paid` 400 gate at line 267 — matches the spec.
